label: Diagram 2.6
caption: Diagram 2.6 Wall type 1 – bonded junction – masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall with solid separating wall
description: An isometric line drawing headed "Diagram 2.6 Wall type 1 – bonded junction – masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall with solid separating wall". Two masonry walls meet at a right angle: the inner leaf of the external cavity wall running across, and the solid separating wall running back from it. Their courses of blocks are bonded into each other at the junction, alternate courses of one wall running through into the other. There are no labels or dimensions.
first_draft: The image shows two diagrams side by side. The left, headed 'Diagram 2.6 Wall type 1 – bonded junction – masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall with solid separating wall', is an isometric line drawing of a masonry corner. Two courses of bricks or blocks meet at a right angle, illustrating a bonded junction between wall leaves; no dimensions appear. The right diagram, headed 'Diagram 2.8 Wall type 1 – position of openings in masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall', is a perspective view of a wall corner with a rectangular opening drawn in its face. A label 'Separating wall' points to the left wall, and 'Masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall' sits below the rectangle. Two dimensions are marked: x, the horizontal distance from the corner to the left edge of the opening, and y, the vertical height of the opening. Text above reads 'x not more than 700mm and y not less than 1m'. Beneath the right diagram, a heading reads 'Junctions with an external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf', followed by cut-off running text beginning '2.19 Where the external wall is a cavity wall'.
